Agendas and Meeting Minutes

All members of the public and relevant Government Departments and Agencies are hereby notified that Ordinary Council Meetings will be held at the Council Chambers in Lockhart River every 3rd Wednesday of each month. Please forward all items to be included in the agenda immediately to ceo@lockhart.qld.gov.au
